Oven Baked Eggplant
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 16, 2009 - 12:03am

Ingredients




Eggplant
Italian dressing
Breadcrumbs

Preparation

1 Peel and slice eggplant. dip in italian dressing (even fat free works). 2 Coat well in breadcrumbs. 3 Spray a cookie sheet with Pam, place eggplant slices on sheet, bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes, turning once.
